content: Strong app achieves best-in-class lifting log speed: 3 taps to log a set once inside a session. Core affordances: (1) previous-session weights auto-populated for every exercise; (2) rest timer auto-starts after set is logged; (3) plate calculator one tap from any set; (4) warm-up calculator built-in. The app pre-fills last weight + reps as a baseline; athlete taps to adjust and check the set. Everything is optimized for the assumption the user is mid-workout with 60-90 seconds of rest.
